subject: Proposal: credits stacking and tier-cascade for Hosted API commit pilots
messages:
From: Sarah Mills <sarah@launchworks.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + pilot credits question for LaunchWorks POC

Hi Kimberly / Aditya —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. LaunchWorks is excited to proceed with a small POC to validate integration latency and cost profile on your Hosted API. Before we lock in the calendar I wanted to clarify how Redwood treats multiple incentive lines: can onboarding credits (for integration support) stack with pilot credits tied to a committed volume? Our procurement lead will need a simple term sheet showing both amounts and any carve-outs.

Rough profile: 2M tokens/month expected during the 8-week POC peak, but first 2 weeks are integration-only (very low). Target go/no-go decision after 8 weeks.

Main asks:
- Can pilot credits be used against per-token usage (hosted API) and applied before or after any percentage discount for commit?
- Are credits time-bound or do they roll into the committed-period calculations?
- Any existing templates for a pilot + commit cascade you can share?

If we can get a short term sheet and an expected timeline this week we can fast-track legal approval on our side.

Cheers,
Sarah
VP, Platform Partnerships
LaunchWorks

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Mills <sarah@launchworks.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + pilot credits question for LaunchWorks POC

Hi Sarah —

Great to hear. Short answers up front: yes, pilot credits can be applied to per-token usage on the Hosted API; we can structure those credits to be used before discounts (so they reduce net billable tokens) or after discounts depending on what fits your accounting — we typically see customers prefer credits applied pre-discount for easier internal forecasting. Credits are time-bound by default for pilots but can be extended if you move into a committed tier.

I'll sketch a pragmatic approach below and attach a draft term sheet: RW proposes a 4-week technical pilot with $12,500 in pilot credits (applied pre-discount), plus a separate $7,500 onboarding credit for integration assistance. If you convert to a three-tier commit within 30 days after the pilot, we can cascade the credits into the committed term as a one-time offset, and offer a stepped per-token discount schedule on monthly usage.

Proposed pilot -> commit cascade (high level):
- 4-week pilot: $12,500 credits (pre-discount) + $7,500 onboarding credits (applied to professional services)
- Commit tiers (monthly token volumes):
  * Tier A: 0-50M tokens -> 3% per-token discount
  * Tier B: 50M-250M tokens -> 8% per-token discount
  * Tier C: 250M+ tokens -> 15% per-token discount
- If you sign a 12-month commitment within 30 days of pilot completion we apply the pilot credits as a one-time credit against the first invoice.

Questions for you to confirm:
1) Do you want the pilot credits to be applied before or after the commit discounts? (we suggested before)
2) Expected average monthly token volume after go-live (so we can price the tiers appropriately)
3) Any procurement constraints around credit expiry or rollover

Attached: RW_credits_term_sheet_v1.pdf — this is a draft commercial layout and examples of how credits offset billings.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
[attachment: RW_credits_term_sheet_v1.pdf (PDF, 128KB)]

From: Sarah Mills <sarah@launchworks.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, contracts@launchworks.com
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + pilot credits question for LaunchWorks POC

Thanks Kimberly — that helps a lot. A few clarifications from procurement and product:

- Procurement would strongly prefer credits to be applied before discounts (so net billings are clear on invoice).
- We expect a conservative production run of ~18M tokens/month after the pilot (months 2–4 post-go-live we expect a ramp toward ~60M by month 9).
- Onboarding credit should absolutely be applied to PS invoices only (we need a line-item showing PS discount).
- Can you confirm whether the $12.5k pilot credit can be split across multiple invoices during the pilot window? We sometimes have staggered billing.

If you can reflect the pre-discount application and split-usage behavior in the term sheet we can get budget approved faster.

Happy to hop on a short call if that's easier — do you have 30 minutes tomorrow morning?

Warmly,
Sarah

Hi team —

Appreciate the profile, Sarah. Below is a commercially pragmatic offer that we can commit to quickly if LaunchWorks signs the pilot SOW and confirms the post-pilot conversion timeline. This is written with the procurement constraints you mentioned in mind.

Commercial summary (proposal):
- Pilot (4 weeks): $12,500 pilot credits applied pre-discount, able to be pro-rated across multiple invoices during the pilot window.
- Onboarding: $7,500 credit restricted to PS invoices (line item) — expires 90 days from pilot start.
- Conversion incentives: if LaunchWorks signs a 12-month committed agreement within 30 days of the pilot finish date, Redwood will:
  * Apply pilot credits as a one-time invoice credit on first committed invoice
  * Provide a one-time conversion credit equal to 10% of average monthly usage for months 1–3 (capped at $25k)
- Commit discount schedule (monthly billed usage):
  * Tier A: up to 25M -> 4% discount
  * Tier B: >25M to 150M -> 9% discount
  * Tier C: >150M -> 17% discount

Notes:
- Discounts are applied to the per-token list price; credits offset billed amount before discounts (per your preference).
- Credits can be pro-rated across invoices during the pilot; PS credit must be invoiced separately so procurement can track it.
- We can also include a 30-day rollback clause for the pilot if integration blocks prevent testing.

If that looks OK I will have our commercial SOW and a DocuSign envelope ready by EOD tomorrow. Attaching a sample usage CSV so you can validate the numbers against your expected pattern.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Intro + pilot credits question for LaunchWorks POC

One quick operational detail from my side — legal and billing have two standard asks we should confirm before sending SOW to procurement:

1) SLA / uptime credits: if LaunchWorks is negotiating higher SLOs we need to make sure any uptime credits are explicitly stated and do not interact with commercial credits (pilot/PS).
2) Rollover: pilot credits do not roll into ongoing committed credits by default; they can be cascaded as a one-time invoice credit only if conversion occurs within the 30-day window.

Also confirm whether the pilot credit application "pre-discount" means the per-token discount is computed on (list_price - credit_applied) or that the credit is a post-discount invoice line item. Our recommendation (and Aditya's note) is to apply the credit before calculating the discount. That keeps invoices simpler.

I can loop in legal to fast-track redlines if Sarah confirms the two points above.

—Marissa
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

2) Onboarding credits applied to PS invoices only and expire 90 days from pilot start (confirmed)
3) Pilot credits can be cascaded into first committed invoice if a 12-month agreement is executed within 30 days of pilot end (confirmed)

We are ready for the SOW and term sheet. Please send the DocuSign envelope and a final term sheet with the specific invoice examples (showing pre-discount calculation) and we will route for signature.
